module.purpose: Defines the shared TypeScript contracts, state unions, layout identifiers, and styling extension points used to configure and compose the booking interface across web and platform integrations.
module.summary: This module is the type boundary for the booking experience. It describes booking inputs such as event identity, organization context, dates, durations, rescheduling data, instant meetings, CRM metadata, localization, and feature flags. It also combines hook return values into wrapped component properties, distinguishes platform and web verification behavior, and centralizes view, state, layout, area, and customizable CSS class contracts.
module.businessContext:
Supports scheduling and rescheduling customer bookings across user, team, organization, and platform contexts.
Type failures can prevent availability selection, verification, booking confirmation, or branded booking presentation.
